{{Quote|It is a vast criminal syndicate&hellip;its influence felt on every planet from the Core Worlds to the Outer Rim. Black Sun has existed for hundreds of years, and embedded itself in the very fiber of the galaxy. The resources at its disposal are almost limitless. The soldiers under its command number in the tens of thousands. The ignorant even call it the most powerful force in the known universe.|Darth Sidious, to Darth Maul|<ref name="Darth Maul (2000) 1">[[Darth Maul (2000) 1|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Black Sun''' was the most powerful and infamous crime syndicate of its time in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Black Sun was an immense and far-reaching criminal organization with tentacles spreading all over every political, corporate, social and illegal life throughout [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The syndicate's vast corrupting reach infiltrated, and extended into various entities throughoutt galactic history, including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], local governments, corporations, guilds, even the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SotES" />

Below the leader of Black Sun were nine [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] (Old [[Tionese/Legends|Tionese]] for "nephew") who coordinated their tens of thousands minions of the organization.<ref name="secrets" /> Each Vigo ruled over his or her own territory and [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

Vigos, with their own sub-lieutenants and trustees ruled their own vast criminal network where tens of thousands of [[operative/Legends|operatives]]—[[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Spy/Legends|spies]], even minor criminals—obeyed the Vigos and sub-lieutenants.<ref name="SotES" /> Smuggling was merely the tip of the iceberg for the infamous organization,<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Black Sun Smuggler">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Black Sun Smuggler}}</ref> which engaged in virtually every known type of illegal activity—even operating ventures such as [[Rodia/Legends|Rodian]] [[casino/Legends|casinos]].<ref name="secrets" /> Its immense resources rivalled those of a large planetary army, including access to foot soldiers,<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Black Sun Minion">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Black Sun Minion}}</ref> and its intelligence network reached into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] and [[Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] offices, rivaling the scope and accuracy of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] itself.<ref name="secrets">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref><ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Black Sun Thug">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Black Sun Thug}}</ref>

On the surface, Black Sun operated through seemingly legitimate covers; its front operatives included free-traders, [[politics|politicians]], and [[NewsNet]] [[journalist]]s. Communication used spynet methods such as drop-points, monikers, ciphers and double agents; practices varied among Vigos. [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenaries]] and double-agents, caused rival syndicates or governments to take the blame of Black Sun's activities. Black Sun stepped in filling the vacuum left by rivals who weakened each other. Many of them were unaware that they were even working for Black Sun; per the usual practice of spy networks, each operative knew only their immediate contacts during a mission, blind to the bigger plan. Some operatives unwittingly belonged to more than one Vigo network. Petty criminals and thugs were at the bottom of the chain, expendable, replacable, and oblivious of the network above them.<ref name="SotES" />

Black Sun was known to have several hideouts in remote, scarcely populated planets of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

==History==
===Formation===
{{Quote|If we had more Jedi like you working the streets, Black Sun would be a thing of the past.|CSF Officer Stansun to an unidentified Jedi|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Csfblacksunfight.png|thumb|left|250px|CSF officers battle Black Sun members]]
Black Sun was formed at the end of the [[Great Galactic War]]. After the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] soon fell into chaos and [[riot]]ing, overwhelming the already stretched thin [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. Taking advantage of the situation, several prominent gangsters joined together and began seizing control of neighborhoods in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]]. With this, in reference to the gangsters, denizens of the lower levels coined the phrase "better a black sun than none" and the Black Sun crime syndicate was born. Black Sun quickly carved out a [[Black Sun territory|territory]] for itself and developed spice and weapons trafficking operations. Though their advance to claim more sectors was halted by the [[Justicars' Brigade]], the rioting and looting never stopped within their own territory. In the following years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Black Sun's influence stretched beyond Coruscant and the gang became a galactic criminal syndicate. The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] soon came to realize the full situation and CSF forces such as the [[Special tactical unit|Special Tactical Unit]] began actively fighting back to regain the sectors under Black Sun's control. It was during this time that the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] began joint operations with the CSF and [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to counter Black Sun.<ref name="Codex: Black Sun" /> SIS [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] tracked a small cell of criminals consisting of [[Teff'ith]] and others on Coruscant in an effort to discover who was funding the Black Sun slavery ring.<ref name="TORTLS1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>

Around this time, the syndicate began acquiring materials to create [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifles]]. An individual dispatched an associate of theirs to fake a trade to expose Black Sun's dealers.<ref name="Disruptive Behavior">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Disruptive Behavior}}</ref>

===Late Republic era===
{{Quote|Do you wish Black Sun destroyed utterly?" <br />"No. One day it might prove useful to me. For now it must be thrown into disarray so it cannot threaten our designs.|Darth Maul and Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth Maul (2000) 1" />}}
[[File:AlexiMighella-DM3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Alexi Garyn]], head of Black Sun in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], with his [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] bodyguard, [[Mighella]].]]
Although headquartered on Coruscant, the influence of the Black Sun stretched the length of the galaxy. With tens of thousands of foot soldiers and hundreds of leaders based on safe houses and fortresses across the galaxy, the syndicate was both covertly and openly a force to be reckoned with on a galactic scale.<ref name="SWTCWDMSC">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Black Sun had come under the control of [[Alexi Garyn]], who was killed by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] on [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious's]] orders. Other Vigos fell to [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|Darth Maul's lightsaber]] as well, and the organization was severely damaged in accordance with Sidious's plan.<ref name="SWDM">[[Star Wars: Darth Maul (2000)|''Star Wars: Darth Maul'' (2000)]]</ref> It would be about a decade before it had recuperated.<ref name="SWTCWDMSC" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Black Sun exploited the Republic's focus on the war to drastically expand its activities. At that time, a faction of the syndicate<ref name="SWTCWDMSC" /> was controlled by a cabal of [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] nobles under [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]], [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|headquartered]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="SWEBlackSun" /> After [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] murdered Grunseit and his ruling council, [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]] assumed control of the faction and pledged allegiance to Darth Maul, the very man who had almost destroyed the syndicate thirteen years prior who wanted Black Sun's resources allow them to sustain a war without the scrutiny of the Republic. Once in the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] moved Black Sun's Mustafar weapon stores and equipment to [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|their camp]] on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] in preparation for the planned attack on [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. The [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|armed forces]] commanded by Moj were deemed inefficient for a direct attack, however, and so were relocated to Zanbar until a sufficient force had been assembled. After the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] heard that Death Watch and Black Sun were building an army, [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] quickly moved to join the Collective. The last to join were the leaders of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="Eminence" />

Black Sun and Pyke forces (led by Moj and Lom respectively) smuggled themselves into Sundari in crates and launched an attack in [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|the docks]] as part of an elaborate plan to take the city. [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and his Death Watch warriors faced off against them in a sham conflict which ended with the criminals displayed in cuffs before the New Mandalorian crowds in the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]]. The support of the people allowed Vizsla to oust [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] in a quick and bloodless coup.<ref name="ShadesofReason">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>

[[File:Darth_Maul_Black_Sun.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] attacks a Black Sun stronghold.]]
During the war, Black Sun dealt extensively with the plant [[Bota/Legends|bota]], found only on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. Originally, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]] was the main contact with [[Filba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for the smuggling. He was later assassinated by [[Kaird]], a [[Nediji]], following the death of the former operative [[Mathal]].<ref name="Medstar1">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> Another partnership was later established with [[Thula]] and [[Squa Tront]] to secure the bota. Upon learning that the bota was losing its potency, Kaird escaped from Drongar with a supply as a gift for his [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]]; it was subsequently discovered that the case was filled with explosives, in attempt at betrayal by Thula and Tront.<ref name="Medstar2">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

Following the war, [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droids]] were acquired by Black Sun, which utilized them in chop shops on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon novel">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

===The Imperial period===
During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Black Sun was led by [[Dal Perhi]], though his mantle was soon usurped by a Black Sun Vigo named [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. The [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] crimelord would lead Black Sun to unparalleled prestige by the onset of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Assisting [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] Xizor was the feminine [[Human replica droid]], [[Guri]]. Guri acted as bodyguard and assassin for the Falleen Prince. Under Xizor's leadership, Black Sun became so powerful that the Prince was considered by some Coruscant courtiers to be surpassed in power only by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Black Sun's influence was tremendous. They had a practically limitless amount of credits; more than enough to finance any operation they wished to complete. They ruled the underworld and few individuals or organizations dared to cross them or pose a threat to them.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Black Sun set up a remote base on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] from which they planned to steal the stocks of the poisonous [[chronamite]] mineral from the [[Corellian Chemical Corporation/Legends|Corellian Chemical Corporation]]. As the company suspected the local security forces to be infiltrated with Black Sun spies, they decided to hire an independent strike team to attack and destroy the Black Sun base.<ref name="SWG:BSSC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Black Sun Stealing Chronamite}} on Corellia</ref>

====Alliance with the Death Watch====
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Black Sun pursued an alliance with the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a mysterious [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group. Black Sun mercenaries were contracted to defend a [[Death Watch bunker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] where Death Watch crafted [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armors]].<ref name="DWB">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Death%20Watch%20Bunker|text=Death Watch Bunker}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] learnt the existence of the Death Watch bunker. Furthermore, the Hutt discovered that the Black Sun was intending to expand its influence. Jabba therefore paid an informant infiltrated in the Black Sun named [[Stanic Wavingstar]] to spy on its activities. In addition, one of Jabba's minions, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], recruited a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to attack Black Sun enforcers at the Death Watch bunker in order to test the strength of the criminal syndicate. The spacer later prevented a Black Sun assassin to murder Jabba's informant.<ref name="SWG:TI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Troublesome Influences|Tatooine}}</ref>

Shortly after, the Black Sun dispatched a [[Freighter/Legends|heavy freighter]] and a [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunship]] to exfiltrate [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] fugitive droid [[RA-316]] from the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]]. However, the mission failed and all ships were destroyed by Jabba's pilots.<ref name="SWG:Runaways">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Runaways|Tatooine}}</ref>

====Humiliation at Tansarii Point Station====
Black Sun had an interest in [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], they had placed three bases of operations near [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the [[Salient Trinity]], from which they would commit acts of piracy against traders and civilians. A team of Black Sun [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] even managed to infiltrate the station. Black Sun's dominance in the system changed with the arrival of an unknown spacer, brought there by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The spacer ended up in the employ of [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]], who were responsible for law enforcement in and around the station; this proved to have serious consequences for Black Sun. The spacer was involved in an operation that successfully removed the threat from the slicers and would also fight against the local Black Sun pirates in the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], in which all of the Black Sun commanders in the system were killed and most of the local Black Sun wing destroyed. As a result of the battle, the Black Sun presence in the system diminished drastically and their influence disappeared totally.<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

Later, Black Sun tried to regain some influence in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], by attempting to purchase the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] off a rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], called [[Andal Sait]].

====The Zann Consortium====
Xizor also dealt with a rival criminal organization, the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Xizor hired [[Tyber Zann]], leader of the Consortium, to steal [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas from a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. In actuality, Xizor had laid a trap to dispose of Zann. Knowing Vader had recently [[Occupation of Bespin|subjugated]] the planet and [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], he hoped the Dark Lord would intercede and eliminate his competitor. Instead, the move backfired on Xizor. Zann betrayed Xizor by planting evidence that pointed responsibility for the theft towards Black Sun. Vader quickly learned of this, furthering the rift between himself and Xizor.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

====3 ABY====
Xizor had a personal reason to hate Vader: after an accident at a biological weapons laboratory on Xizor's homeworld [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] ordered the area and all of the contaminated Falleen to be "sterilized." The entire area and all living within&mdash;some 200,000 Falleen, including Xizor's family&mdash;were obliterated to prevent the spread of the deadly disease. It was a small price to pay for what could potentially have been, according to Vader, a planet-killing outbreak. Xizor deleted all records of his family's deaths to hide any apparent motives for a grudge against Vader. When Xizor learned that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was the son of Vader, he planned to kill Skywalker, hoping to permanently discredit Vader in the eyes of the Emperor.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)" />

[[File:Xizor_and_Guri.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], galactic crimelord, with his bodyguard [[Guri]].]]

By the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Xizor had found himself and his organization in close dealings with the Emperor. As part of a grand scheme to ultimately destroy the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and corrupt Luke Skywalker, Palpatine made good use of Xizor's legitimate enterprise, [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]]. XTS would contract 300 ships to the Empire to help transport construction material to the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] construction site over the [[Endor/Legends|Sanctuary Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. Palpatine's desire to involve Black Sun in his most personal orchestrations was to use the organization as a pawn to plant the secret construction plans to the second Death Star into the hands of the Alliance. Trusting Black Sun, the Alliance would believe that the plans they acquired were legitimate.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)" />

Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Ororo Transportation]] tried to usurp control of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] operations in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]], controlled by the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Crime Syndicate]], an organization in league with Black Sun. In a move both to cripple Ororo and improve his stock with the Emperor, Xizor informed the Empire of an Ororo-owned shipyard in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]] being used by the Rebellion as a repair dock. The Empire, under the personal command of Vader, quickly [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards|destroyed the shipyard]] and the majority of Rebel forces there; simultaneously, Xizor personally dispatched Guri to assassinate the leaders of Ororo.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)" /> In addition, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] and [[Emon Azzameen]] also planted a listening device, and got a Black Sun insignia for their troubles, to which the former would place at his room as part of his collection.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

When Vader finally had evidence of Xizor's attempt to kill Skywalker, he confronted him in orbit over Coruscant during the [[Battle over Coruscant]]. In his personal flagship [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], Vader destroyed Xizor's personal [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]], ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'', with Xizor aboard. Additionally, Xizor's castle had been destroyed by Skywalker, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. The loss of its leader and so much of its infrastructure crippled Black Sun to such an extent that it would not recover for nearly twenty years.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)" />

===New Republic and beyond===
[[File:Savan-SOTEE4.png|thumb|right|150px|[[Savan]], Xizor's niece.]]

Several attempts to restore the power of the syndicate were made, including one by Xizor's niece [[Savan]] and one by the [[Jeodu]] [[Dequc]], who termed his enterprise "[[Black Nebula (organization)|Black Nebula]]."

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], as part of the New Republic's attempt to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberate]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], sixteen of the galaxy's most notorious criminals were released from the prison colony on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in order to cause disruptions that were intended to allow infiltration by New Republic agents, including the members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. This tactic backfired, as the released prisoners (including [[Zekka Thyne]] and former [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Fliry Vorru]]) went on to successfully resurrect Black Sun.

By the time of the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn crisis]] and the return of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Black Sun was headed by [[Y'ull Acib]]. Working with [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa the Hutt]], he attempted to take control of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The "Council of Blood"|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]], to no avail. Acib was then overthrown by [[Durga Besadii Tai]] after this, who ruled Black Sun until his own death.

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Czethros]] attempted to bring back the criminal syndicate to its former glory and to dominate the galaxy. He planned to take over by sending spies and operatives in the most key points in it, and sending them out all at once. He sent them in many places including [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Anobis]], [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], and [[Crystal Reef]]. In their failed [[Battle of Kessel (Black Sun Insurgency)|Kessel uprising]], the [[New Jedi Order]] retrieved Czethros and the signal he planned to send. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], then one at a time, warned the locals, sent the signal to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and arrested thousands of Black Sun agents across the galaxy and effectively destroyed the organization.

In [[43 ABY]], the [[New Jedi Order]] collected clues about a reorganization of the organization.

===Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire===
By the time of the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Black Sun was still active, with its structure unchanged over the centuries. However, the organization had abandoned its former secrecy and now openly displayed its symbol on ships and stations to intimidate rivals and victims.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> It was dealing in illegal [[Yuuzhan Vong]] weapons,<ref name="Legacy 2006 16">[[Legacy (2006) 16|''Legacy'' (2006) 16]]</ref> extortion<ref name="Legacy 2006 23">[[Legacy (2006) 23|''Legacy'' (2006) 23]]</ref> and was particularly active in the Outer Rim, where it was responsible for attacks on [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] convoys.<ref name="SWL37">[[Legacy (2006) 37|''Legacy'' (2006) 37]]</ref>
